failure.mechanism_observed: The one-shot readyReplicas == 1 guard failed before storage work; only storage executed and the other 20 cases did not run. Lease PUT/GET timeouts preceded controller exit 1 at 23:42:47Z; it restarted at 23:42:48Z and became Ready 11 seconds later. It was not OOM-killed.
failure.unknown: Previous controller stderr was not captured, so the exit cause is unknown. The lease timeouts are preceding events, not an established cause.
